name: Laboratory DC Battery Source (Dual-Cell 3.0V) & Dry Cell
semanticDescription: Laboratory DC power source comprising a dual-cell AA series battery holder (1.5V x 2 = 3.0V DC) with knurled brass binding posts and authentic cell jackets, paired with a detailed longitudinal cutaway section of a Leclanché chemical dry cell showing zinc anode can, ammonium chloride electrolyte, manganese dioxide depolarizer, and central graphite cathode rod for CBSE Class 10 and 12 electricity curricula.
